mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the current temperature is 78 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park, and we are seeing an air quality index of 53 today.

The City of Verona provides engineering updates via AECOM for council review, and if you are looking to give back or stay active, the Verona Recreation Department is currently hiring for adult fitness instructors and the Senior Center offers free tri-shaw bike rides.
There is plenty to do in our community today, including live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, along with a Girls Try Hockey session at the Verona Ice Arena.

Looking back at the weekly police report, on Thursday, an officer conducted a traffic stop for a vehicle with a flat tire and no active tail lights, which resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
